lead: Materials, tools and machines for making things by hand, organised by craft (painting, printmaking, sewing, yarn, paper, jewellery, pottery, glass, leather, modelling), then material kind, then maker and named line.

depts.note: Paint is organised by medium, then house and line; Colour Index pigment codes are the comparison axis.

b.w: Colour Index International (SDC/AATCC); printed on artist-grade tubes
b.v: Colour Index codes, e.g. PB29, PR254; single-pigment vs convenience mix

b.w: ASTM D4303 / D5098; makers' permanence ratings
Pigment load and filler; every major house sells both tiers
Mould-made cotton papers (Arches, Saunders Waterford) are the watercolour benchmark
b.v: wood pulp < cotton blend < 100% cotton; hot/cold-pressed/rough; gsm

s.brief: Organise each paint kind as house → line archetypes (e.g. Winsor & Newton Professional vs Cotman, Daniel Smith Extra Fine, Schmincke Horadam, Holbein, Sennelier, M. Graham, Golden Heavy Body/Fluid, Liquitex, Old Holland, Michael Harding, Williamsburg, Gamblin), originator first. Use `t` for grades and formats (tube, pan, half-pan, water-mixable oil). Trim Blick house-brand and SKU duplicates; existing lines become versions. Add dry pigment (Kremer, Sennelier) and encaustic/egg tempera as new kinds. Record Colour Index pigment as the detail axis (`dt`).

k.brief: Loose artists' pigment for hand-mulling; Kremer, Sennelier, Natural Pigments.
Wax and egg-based traditional paints; R&F encaustic etc.
Rename from 'Acrylic and other mediums'; types: acrylic medium, oil medium/solvent, picture varnish.

s.brief: Brushes by hair: Kolinsky sable archetypes (Winsor & Newton Series 7 first, Escoda Reserva/Kolinsky-Tajmyr, da Vinci Maestro, Rosemary & Co), synthetic sable, hog bristle. Shapes (round, flat, filbert, rigger, mop) are `t`. Easels: lyre, H-frame, French box easel (Jullian original) as archetypes; trim Blick/Meeden SKUs. Pentel Aquash water brush stays as a version under watercolour brushes.

k.brief: Rename from 'Artist brush'.
Types: wooden, porcelain, stay-wet, enamel tin.
Open Box M, Guerrilla Painter, Strada etc.

s.brief: Paper by maker and line: Arches, Saunders Waterford, Fabriano Artistico, Hahnemühle, Canson Mi-Teintes, Sennelier La Carte, Clairefontaine Pastelmat, Strathmore series, Stillman & Birn series (keep as versions). Weight, surface and format (pad, block, sheet) are `t`. Canvas: cotton duck vs linen (Claessens, Belle Arti) as types.

k.brief: Rename from 'Watercolour paper pad'; pads, blocks and sheets are types.

s.brief: Archetypes: graphite (Staedtler Mars Lumograph, Faber-Castell 9000, Tombow Mono, Derwent Graphic), coloured pencil (Faber-Castell Polychromos, Caran d'Ache Luminance/Pablo, Prismacolor Premier, Derwent Lightfast; watercolour pencils as type e.g. Albrecht Dürer, Museum Aquarelle), soft pastels (Sennelier, Unison, Schmincke, Rembrandt, Girault, PanPastel), oil pastels (Sennelier original 1949, Caran d'Ache Neopastel). Merge 'Other pastels' into soft pastels (PanPastel). Add an eraser and blending-tool kind.

k.brief: Absorbs 'Other pastels'; hard pastels and pastel pencils as types.
Types: vine, willow, compressed, charcoal pencil.
Kneaded eraser, blending stump, tortillon.

s.brief: Archetypes: alcohol markers (Copic Sketch/Ciao originator, Prismacolor, Chartpak, Winsor & Newton Promarker, Ohuhu), paint markers (Posca), brush pens (Pentel, Tombow Dual Brush, Kuretake), fineliners (Sakura Pigma Micron originator, Copic Multiliner, Staedtler Pigment Liner), drawing ink (Higgins, Winsor & Newton, Dr. Ph. Martin's, Sennelier). Rename 'Other drawing pens and markers' to fineliner; move the Uni Posca there to paint markers. Add dip pen and nib (Zebra G, Nikko G, Hunt 102).

k.brief: Rename from 'Art ink'.

s.brief: Restraint: keep kit kinds, trim to market-covering brands; theme and size as types.

b.w: Printmaking papers are judged on sizing and fibre
b.v: Somerset, Stonehenge, BFK Rives; kozo/gampi washi for mokuhanga

b.w: The Four Treasures of the Study tradition
b.v: brush hair, inkstick soot (pine vs oil), inkstone origin (Duan, She), xuan grade

s.brief: Organise by process: relief (lino, woodcut, mokuhanga), intaglio (etching, drypoint), screen printing. Archetypes: Pfeil and Flexcut gouges, Speedball/Essdee lino cutters, Japanese baren (hon-baren vs plastic), etching presses (Conrad, Blick/Ternes-Burton, Xcut tabletop). Add printmaking paper and etching tools & grounds. Traditions: Japanese mokuhanga, Western etching.

k.brief: Squeegees and emulsion as types.

s.brief: New shelf for the Four Treasures of the Study (brush, inkstick, inkstone, paper) plus washi and seal paste. Archetypes: Hu brush (Huzhou), Hui inkstick (Huizhou), Duan and She inkstones, Xuan paper (Jing County), Japanese sumi and Nara inksticks (Kobaien), Japanese gansai (Kuretake), washi (Mino, Echizen, Hosokawa — UNESCO). Traditions entries: Four Treasures, washi, Japanese calligraphy.

depts.note: Machines are tier picks with collectable vintage versions; fabric is a variety area organised by fibre and design house.

b.w: Long-life metal-frame machines are the enthusiast benchmark
b.v: plastic chassis < metal frame; mechanical vs computerised; throat space

b.w: How fabric shops and pattern envelopes specify cloth
b.v: gsm or oz/yd²; quilting cotton, lawn, twill, knit

s.brief: Kind → archetype → version with vintage icons: Singer 15, Singer 201, Singer 221 Featherweight, Bernina 530/830 Record, Pfaff 130, Elna Supermatic, Necchi, Juki TL-2010Q, Janome Memory Craft, Brother Innov-is; trim Singer Heavy Duty/Brother SKU runs to versions. Treadle/hand-crank as types. Collapse all spare parts into one entry (needles kept separate as a consumable: Schmetz, Organ). Add coverstitch machine.

k.brief: Rename from 'Overlock machine'; serger alias.

k.n: Sewing machine feet and spare parts
k.brief: One entry: presser feet, bobbins, bobbin cases, needle plates, extension tables, oil as types.

s.brief: Organise by fibre/cloth then design house and named cloth: quilting cotton (Robert Kaufman Kona, Moda, Art Gallery, FreeSpirit, Ruby Star), printed lawn (Liberty Tana Lawn), selvedge denim (Cone Mills, Kaihara, Kuroki), wool cloth (Harris Tweed, Linton, Abraham Moon), linen (Irish, Belgian), silk, wax print (Vlisco). Precuts (fat quarter, jelly roll, charm pack) as types of quilting cotton.

k.brief: Rename from 'Cotton fabric'.

s.brief: Products for colouring cloth with tradition entries: shibori, indigo/aizome, batik, adire, bandhani, boro. Archetypes: Procion MX fibre-reactive dye (Jacquard, Dharma), Rit, Dylon; natural indigo; tjanting and batik wax. Fabric paint brands Jacquard, Pebeo Setacolor, Tulip.

Mostly restraint: types for zips (coil, metal, invisible), buttons, elastic, trims. Thread by house: Gütermann, Coats, Aurifil, Mettler; YKK and Riri for zips. Interfacing (Vilene/Pellon) and batting (Warm & Natural, Hobbs) by fibre types.

Archetypes: Gingher and Kai shears, Clover/Tulip hand needles, Wonder Clips, Olfa/Creative Grids rulers, adjustable dress forms (Dritz, Adjustoform). Add sewing pattern (Big Four: Vogue, Butterick, McCall's, Simplicity; Burda; indie houses) as the object/format, and measuring & marking tools.

k.brief: Tape measure, tailor's chalk, seam gauge, seam ripper.

depts.note: Yarn follows Ravelry's axes: weight, fibre and named yarn line.

b.w: Ravelry / Craft Yarn Council standard weights
b.v: lace < fingering < sport < DK < worsted < aran < bulky < super bulky
superwash vs untreated; woollen- vs worsted-spun; ply

s.brief: Split the old yarn kind by fibre. Archetypes are named yarn lines (Cascade 220, Malabrigo Rios, Rowan Felted Tweed, Lion Brand Wool-Ease, Drops, Brooklyn Tweed Shelter, Jamieson's Shetland Spindrift, Lopi, Paintbox; sock: Regia, Opal, Lang Jawoll; Rowan Kidsilk Haze) with Ravelry weight in `t`/`dt`. Distribute the 53 old models to the matching fibre kind. Macramé cord stays here.

k.brief: Old 'Knitting and crochet yarn'; distribute non-wool lines to the sibling kinds.

k.n: Mohair, alpaca, cashmere and silk yarn

s.brief: Archetypes: needles (addi, ChiaoGoo, HiyaHiya, Knit Picks, Lantern Moon, Clover; interchangeable sets as type), hooks (Clover Amour, Tulip Etimo, Boye, Furls). Add yarn swift and ball winder, blocking tools, and stitch markers & notions.

Archetypes: DMC Mouliné Stranded Cotton (originator), Anchor, Appleton crewel wool, Zweigart Aida/evenweave, Olympus/Daruma sashiko thread, Oliver Twist punch needle. Traditions: sashiko, boro, crewelwork, Hardanger, kantha. Merge both kit kinds.

k.brief: Aida, evenweave, needlepoint canvas as types.

s.brief: Archetypes: Ashford Traditional and Kiwi, Schacht Matchless, Louët S10, Lendrum, Majacraft wheels; Turkish, top-whorl and support spindles; charkha; fibre by breed and preparation (Merino, BFL, Shetland; top, roving, batt). Add hand and drum carders.

Dissolve 'Other looms': place its Schacht models (Wolf/Baby Wolf, Jane, Lilli, Spring, David) under the right loom kinds. Archetypes: Ashford Knitter's Loom, Schacht Cricket and Flip, Louët, Glimåkra; Brother/Silver Reed and Passap knitting machines, Addi Express. Add shuttles, reeds and weaving accessories.

k.brief: Absorbs 'Other looms'; redistribute its models across the loom kinds on this shelf.

s.brief: Archetypes: Japanese origami paper (kami, tant, Origamido), quilling strips, cardstock (Neenah, Bazzill), patterned paper ranges, washi tape (MT originator, Kamoi Kakoshi). Add marbling supplies (ebru, suminagashi traditions) and bookbinding tools & materials (awl, linen thread, book cloth). Scrapbook album stays here.

Archetypes: Sizzix Big Shot (originator manual die-cutter), Spellbinders Platinum, Tim Holtz Distress ink (Ranger), VersaFine/VersaMark (Tsukineko), Hero Arts and Altenew stamps, Fiskars punches/trimmers.

b.v: Japanese seed beads (Miyuki, Toho) > Czech (Preciosa) > unbranded

s.brief: Archetypes: Miyuki Delica (cylinder), Toho Treasure, Preciosa Rocailles; Czech fire-polished; shaped pressed beads (SuperDuo, Tila, Rulla, O-bead); lampwork beads (Venetian/Murano tradition); freshwater and Swarovski/Preciosa crystal pearls; Swarovski (craft-channel supply ended around 2020, to verify) and Preciosa rhinestones.
Restraint: merge small findings; metal and finish as types; keep wire/solder as kinds with gauge/hardness/alloy types.

Archetypes: Lindstrom and Wubbers pliers, Knew Concepts and Pike saw frames, Smith Little Torch, bench pin and jeweller's bench (Durston, GRS), ring mandrel; metal clay (Art Clay Silver, PMC originator); vitreous enamel (Thompson). Bead looms (Mirrix).

b.w: Orton pyrometric cones; clays and glazes are rated by cone
b.v: low fire cone 06–04 · mid cone 5–6 · high cone 10

s.brief: Clay bodies by firing range with named bodies (Potclays, Valentine, Laguna B-Mix, Standard 266, Limoges porcelain); polymer clay (Fimo, Sculpey, Cernit, Kato); plasticine/oil clay (Newplast, Plastiline, Chavant NSP, Monster Clay). Add pottery hand tools.

k.brief: Plasticine and oil-based sculpting clay.
Ribs, loop tools, wire cutters, banding wheel (Mudtools, Kemper, DiamondCore).

s.brief: Glaze archetypes are named glaze families (celadon, tenmoku, shino, ash, crackle/raku, crystalline) with commercial lines (Amaco Potter's Choice, Mayco Stroke & Coat, Coyote, Botz, Spectrum). Add kintsugi repair kit (urushi vs epoxy) with a kintsugi tradition entry.
Archetypes: Shimpo VL-Whisper, Brent CXC, kick wheels (Leach), Pacifica; kilns (Skutt, L&L, Paragon, Olympic, Nabertherm, Rohde). Kiln furniture and one spare-parts entry.

k.brief: Rename from 'Kiln element and parts'.

b.w: Fused glass must share a coefficient of expansion

s.brief: Sheet glass by maker: Bullseye, Oceanside (ex-Spectrum), Kokomo, Youghiogheny, Wissmach, Uroboros, Lamberts mouth-blown; lampwork rods Effetre/Moretti, Hot Head and Nortel torches; Toyo cutters, Glastar/Inland grinders, Paragon/Skutt fusing kilns. Add copper foil and lead came. Traditions: Tiffany copper-foil, Murano lampwork.

k.brief: Fusing glass as COE types.

s.brief: Archetypes: Venetian smalti (Orsoni), vitreous glass tile (Bisazza), ceramic and stone tesserae; Leponitt wheeled nippers. Traditions: Byzantine/Roman mosaic.
Restraint plus market leaders: ArtResin, Resin Obsession, Smooth-On (Mold Star, Ecoflex), Alja-Safe; types for epoxy vs polyurethane resin.
Restraint: wax types (soy, paraffin, beeswax, coconut), wick holder merged into wick; melt-and-pour vs cold-process bases as types.

depts.note: Leather is organised by tannage, then tannery and named leather.

b.w: Tannery specifications; thickness in oz or mm
b.v: chrome < combination < vegetable-tanned; full-grain > top-grain > corrected

s.brief: Tannery → named leather archetypes: Horween Chromexcel, Dublin and Shell Cordovan; Badalassi Carlo Pueblo and Minerva Box; Walpier Buttero; Conceria La Bretagna; Wickett & Craig and Hermann Oak harness/tooling; Tempesta Elbamatt. Weight and colour as `dt`. Add tannery brand entries.

Archetypes: French pricking irons and diamond chisels (Vergez Blanchard, KS Blade, Amy Roke, Crimson Hide), round and skiving knives, Craftool stamps and swivel knife (Tandy) with Sheridan-style carving tradition, Fiebing's dyes, Ritza Tiger and Vinybond threads, stitching pony.

k.brief: Round knife, head knife, skiving knife.

s.brief: Merge the seating materials; add basketry willow. Traditions: Somerset willow, Shaker taping, Japanese bamboo basketry, Nantucket baskets.

k.brief: Seagrass, fibre rush, Shaker tape as types.

s.brief: Home flower arranging (not trade floristry): trim OASIS SKUs to types. Add ikebana kenzan (Ikenobo, Sogetsu traditions) and flower press.
Restraint: keep three kinds; trim pyrography models to market-covering makers (Razertip, Colwood, Walnut Hollow).

Tier kinds with a few archetypes: X-Acto #1 knife with #11 blade (originator), OLFA snap-off, OLFA/Fiskars rotary cutters (rotary blades as a type), Cricut Maker/Explore, Silhouette Cameo, Brother ScanNCut; Cricut EasyPress and Siser heat presses. Add craft vinyl (Siser EasyWeed HTV, Oracal 651).

k.brief: Absorbs rotary cutter blades as a type.

s.brief: Restraint: merge glue sticks and skillet into the glue gun kind; trim to market brands (Aleene's, UHU, Bostik, Mod Podge, DecoArt Americana, FolkArt).

k.brief: Glue sticks and glue skillet as types.

depts.note: Supplies for building and painting kits and miniatures; the kits themselves live in Toys & Games.

b.w: Determines thinner, primer and layering order

s.brief: Archetypes: Tamiya Color acrylic and Extra Thin Cement, Vallejo Model Color/Model Air, Citadel (Games Workshop), Army Painter, AK Interactive, Humbrol enamel, Testors, Mr. Color/Mr. Surfacer (GSI Creos), Milliput, Mig/AK weathering. Add weathering products and hobby tools (sprue cutters: God Hand).

Archetypes: Iwata Eclipse/HP-CS, Revolution, Custom Micron; Badger Patriot/Renegade; Paasche VL/H; Harder & Steenbeck Infinity/Evolution; Sparmax. Compressors: Iwata Smart Jet, Sparmax, SilentAire. One spare-parts entry.

k.brief: Nozzles, needles, hoses as types.
